LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Hawaii

Visitors aged 15 or older need a recreational marine fishing licence. Hawaii also has a separate licence for introduced freshwater game fish.

  • Selected calendar day$20 USD
  • 7 days$40 USD
  • 1 year$70 USD
  • 7 days$10 USD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • The 2026 Kokee season runs June 20–September 30, 6 a.m.–6 p.m.
  • Report at the check station before and after fishing.
  • Use one line and one hook; corn bait and treble hooks are prohibited.
  • Use the named-water entry for Kokee streams / Kauai; check seasonal, tackle and catch limits official regulations ↗

Full Hawaii licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
